Great Steak, Nice Atmosphere
Mar 2022
Went here for an anniversary dinner on a Tuesday evening and loved it! It's situated on the second floor of a building with multiple other eateries.

We had a Lobster pasta to start which was lacking in flavor. It was made up for by the 3 steak platter that was delicious, especially the tenderloin. One of the best pieces of steak I've had in Vietnam. We also had the chocolate dessert which was also delicious.

Shoutout to our waiter Henry who was helpful and friendly!

Highly recommend!

Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam66 contributions

Simply Super - don’t miss this place
Jul 2020
Visit this place with my friend and we really enjoyed it, the decor’s wonderful! Not over fussy with super lighting helping to create a lovely atmosphere. Clearly much thought has gone into how the restaurant presents itself, we started off with a smoked scallop then mussels in bow, the presentation & taste were glorious. We selected Share Meat Platter for main-course & it came really nice, the steak cooked perfectly! Great selection of wine and a super gin martini cocktail. All price is super affordable. Service staff is really friendly, helpful and efficient. The whole experience was tremendous, I would argue you not to miss out this restaurant.
